result.title: Watch and Learn: Teaching Visual In-Context Learning by Removing Textual Shortcuts
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with in context learning compared to their textual counterparts. Our preliminary study shows that VLMs rely on textual shortcuts and underutilize the visual demonstrations. We therefore hypothesize that VLMs are insufficiently trained to perform visual in-context learning (vICL). To this end, we construct MIME, a task-agnostic vICL training set without textual shortcuts. We ensure the instruction does not state the rule linking the demonstration images to their answers, so the model must infer it from the visual demonstrations. Fine-tuning on MIME improves vICL accuracy by 8.1 to 18.0 points across three VLMs, preserves single-image performance, and improves multi-image and text only in-context learning. In contrast, stating the rule in the training data sharply reduces this gain. We further propose DTAD (Demonstration Text Attention Dropout), which randomly withholds demonstration labels during training so that the VLM must infer the rule from the demonstration images. While achieving comparable vICL accuracy to fine-tuning on MIME, DTAD yields more consistent attention to the demonstration images. On TrueMICL, Qwen3-VL-8B trained on MIME matches frontier models such as Claude Opus 5, and surpasses them with DTAD. Finally, adding MIME to the instruction-tuning mix of LLaVA 1.5 13B more than doubles its vICL accuracy without hurting single-image abilities, whereas a same-size multi-image set improves it only slightly. These results suggest that vICL data should be a standard component of VLM training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文通过初步诊断发现 VLM 在视觉上下文学习中依赖文本捷径、未充分利用视觉示范，据此构建不含文本捷径的 MIME 训练集并进行微调，同时提出训练时随机屏蔽示范标签的 DTAD，在多个模型上提升 vICL 准确率并改变注意力分配。
AI.relevance_reason: 「模型是否真正使用视觉证据而非文字旁路」与 LVR 关注的信息坍缩、视觉旁路问题直接对应，其诊断方式与去除捷径的训练监督策略可供核查是否适用于 latent 推理中的视觉贡献分配。
